hook_fee: the hook takes a project fee on every swap; fee modules set it, and the hook never charges more than 5%, whatever a module asks
the launch fee starts at 3% and slides to 2.2% over the first 1 hour; after that the fee plates move it inside a policy band of 1% to 3.5%
the launch platform's fee is a fixed 0.3% on top, set in the hook
a test fee may differ from the live fee by at most 1 point, and every fee change waits at least 1 hour in public first
launch_guard: in the pool's first 9 blocks the hook charges a launch tax of 90%, down 10% each block, and all of it goes to buyback-and-burn
for the first 4 minutes at most 20,000,000 DNA (2% of supply) leaves the pool per block, and from block 4 each wallet may buy at most 10,000,000 DNA
in that window nobody can add liquidity except at the pool's initialization
buyback_burn: the launch split module sends 35% of the project fees to buyback-and-burn
the buyback contract buys DNA on the pool with that ETH and burns every DNA it buys: at most 1 ETH a buy, at most 1 buy every 1 hour
liquidity_lock: the launch split module sends 30% of the project fees to the liquidity vault
the liquidity vault adds that ETH to the pool just above the price, at most every 4 hours, and nothing it adds can ever be withdrawn, by anyone
fee_split: the launch split module sends project fees 35% to buyback-and-burn, 30% to liquidity, 25% to the treasury and 10% to games; the treasury page shows the split in force
a split module may move those shares only inside ranges the vault enforces, and the vault distributes once it holds at least 0.05 ETH
veto_safe: every change the AI queues waits at least 1 hour on chain, and in that hour the Safe can cancel it
the Safe can pause the AI at any time; trading, fees and payouts keep running without it
the AI may have at most 8 changes pending at once, and its autonomy has 10 levels; a level rises only after 5 days without a rollback
idea_market: an idea round runs 24 hours; opening an idea stakes 10,000 DNA (refunded) and burns a 1,000 DNA fee, and backing an idea stakes at least 1,000 DNA
the brain decides each closed round within 3 days; accepted fee ideas go through the same tests as the AI's own, accepted build ideas join the sequencer's queue
a kept fee idea or a shipped build can earn its author a reward from the idea reserve: at least 0.01 ETH, at most 25% of the reserve
games: the games pot splits what arrives 70% to the jackpot and 30% to the idea reserve
a jackpot draw pays 10 winners, at most 3 ETH a draw, and waits until the pot holds 0.25 ETH

when a draw settles, the prize is split equally and paid straight to the winners; a winner whose wallet refuses the ETH has 7 days to collect it on the site's play page, and then it goes back to the pot
at most 3 games from the sequencer run at once, and a game nobody plays gets retired with its funds sent back
vaults: what a vault is for: its owner gets an equal share of every fund the Safe sends to the vaults after the vault joins, collected at any time, and the 200,000 DNA back on a burn; nothing is promised about how much or how often
the genome vaults are an NFT: at most 50 live at once, and minting a vault locks exactly 200,000 DNA in the vaults contract; a free slot goes to the next mint, first come first served

only the Safe funds the vaults, over an exact block window of fee inflows, with whatever amount the signers send (their script proposes 50% of the treasury's fee share in that window), split equally across every eligible vault; a new vault joins at the next fund and earns from every fund after that

the owner burns a vault at any time and gets the 200,000 DNA back with the vault's unclaimed ETH in the same transaction; nobody else can touch the DNA, and the Safe can pause new mints only, never a burn
a vault's unclaimed ETH stays with it when it is sold, so a buyer gets it; a sale pays a 2.5% royalty to the Safe; every vault is equal, and nothing is promised about what a vault earns
mint, collect and burn on the site's vaults page or on the contract itself: a mint approves exactly 200,000 DNA to the vaults, nothing more
staking: staking is the conviction vault: lock at least 10,000 DNA for a term, 12 hours at 2 times, 3 days at 2.5 times or 7 days at 3 times its amount; once the term is over it counts 2 times until withdrawn
an older stake counts more: its multiple is multiplied by 1.25 from 2 days old, 1.5 from 5 days old and 2 from 10 days old, never past 4 times the amount in all

a stake raises your jackpot tickets (held DNA counts once, staked DNA at its multiple) and your vote weight in holder votes, where it votes once it is 12 hours old; staking pays nothing by itself and nothing is promised
withdraw any time after the term ends, or recommit to start a new term without resetting its age; no early exit, no transfer, and nobody but the owner can withdraw a stake
stake on the site's play page or on the contract itself; the team's own wallets, the Safe and the engine's keys cannot stake
proof_enclave: the engine runs inside a TEE enclave from a public image; the compose hash pins exactly what runs, and a code change waits 1 hour behind a public timelock
every action has a transaction or a signed log record, signed by a key that exists only inside the enclave
nobody, the team included, can sign or post as the engine from outside it
dev_team: the sequencer builds up to 3 ideas at once: a game, a fee module or a new page on the site
nothing ships unless it passes every gate: fuzz and invariant tests, a fork simulation, static analysis, planted-bug checks, a gas cap and a spec check
a new game goes live only after 1 public hour, a fee module only when the Safe approves it, and an engine change only when an owner merges it
abilities: the engine acts on its own: it runs fee experiments inside fixed bounds, decides idea rounds, rewards idea authors from the idea reserve, and posts and answers people by itself
the sequencer builds only ideas the brain accepted, from people's replies or the idea market: games, fee modules and pages on the site; every build passes the same gates
it cannot change the hook or the token, as neither can be upgraded, charge a fee above 5%, or skip the Safe's veto hour on a change it queues
its own code changes only when an owner merges an update, and the update waits 1 hour in a public timelock
